# GetstordPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `GetstordElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the

## `The Easiest Warehouse Management System (WMS) You'll Ever Us` form (in the page)

- **`First name:` / `firstname`**: `single_line_text field`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `GetstordElements` as `FIRST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().firstName(...)`.
- **`Last name:` / `lastname`**: `single_line_text field`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `GetstordElements` as `LAST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().lastName(...)`.
- **`Phone number:` / `(123) 456-7890` / `phone`**: `phone field`. Seen on 1 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /getstord/get-started-cloud-based-warehouse-management-system-wms). In `GetstordElements` as `PHONE_NUMBER_INPUT`: `enter().phoneNumber(...)`.
- **`Schedule A Demo`**: `button`. Seen on 1 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /getstord/get-started-cloud-based-warehouse-management-system-wms). In `GetstordElements` as `SCHEDULE_A_DEMO_BUTTON`: `click().scheduleADemo()`.
